paras: I’m a Senior Test Automation Engineer, context-driven tester and quality solution architect with 11+ years in testing and automation. I’m a “best of both worlds” tester — deep testing knowledge plus the engineering to build scalable frameworks and tools tailored to the business.

I follow the Rapid Software Testing approach by James Bach & Michael Bolton — context-driven and exploratory at heart, tailoring strategy to each project instead of one-size-fits-all. As a quality coach, I’ve trained 1000+ professionals within and beyond my organizations. On the side, I build things like Hapti — a workout PWA.
quoteHtml: “Quality is value to some person who matters.”
certs: Test Automation University, The Test Tribe & more
